description: A static power load, used in power flow and operational optimizations. Consumes a set amount of power via active_power or a max_active_power time series. See InterruptiblePowerLoad or StandardLoad for alternatives.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

available.description: Whether the component is online (true) or offline (false). Unavailable components are excluded from simulations.

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

active_power.description: Initial steady-state active power demand. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

reactive_power.description: Initial steady-state reactive power demand. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

base_power.description: Base power of the unit for per unitization. Units: MVA.

power_units.description: Unit basis for this component's power fields (power, ratings, ramp rates): COMPONENT_BASE per unit on base_power, NATURAL_UNITS the field's own unit.

max_active_power.description: Maximum active power that this load can demand. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

max_reactive_power.description: Maximum reactive power that this load can demand. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

conformity.description: Indicates whether the specified load is conforming or non-conforming.

dynamic_injector.description: ID of the corresponding dynamic injection device, if any.

title: PowerLoad
